name: Compaction of Update Information
definition: A process to reduce the bandwidth of node information sent to the CPU by removing duplicate node references using spatial coherence and HistoPyramids.
summary: Compaction of Update Information reduces GPU-to-CPU bandwidth by using HistoPyramids to eliminate duplicate node references via spatial coherence, differing from sibling methods by addressing feedback bottlenecks through GPU-optimized prefix-sum reduction.
